fusions.name: Pulled Thread
fusions.desc: A snagging claw stroke that deals 4 damage, unravels the target's armour so it is 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and has a 25% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Blanketing Collapse
fusions.desc: Collapses your padded weight onto every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 26 damage that ignores resistances, with a 50% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Overstuffed
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Layered Padding
fusions.desc: Every hit you land adds a layer, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per layer (42% at full). Unfed, a layer fades every 10 seconds.
